h1: The kitchen remains. The ideas evolve.

Made in Leigh-on-Sea. Made for the people around us.
h4: Tell us what to cook next
p: A food development kitchen in Leigh-on-Sea, creating collection-only food brands at 93 Leigh Broadway.
One kitchen on Leigh Broadway. A rotating cast of food ideas. We create, test and develop every brand in the real world, with real feedback from the people who collect it.

Nothing is launched from a spreadsheet. A dish goes on the pass, you try it, you tell us what you think, and the menu moves. The brands that earn their place stay. The ones that don’t make room for the next idea.
Each brand has its own personality, menu and following. They share one thing: everything is cooked fresh at 93 Leigh Broadway and collected by you.
Thin crust. Big flavour. South American soul.
New ideas, local favourites and things we are still perfecting.
Three heat levels on trial this week at Chicken Table. Tell us which one stays.
AFTERS. goes big on pistachio this Friday. When they’re gone, they’re gone.
Slower ferment, lighter crust. Your feedback changed the recipe. It’s on the menu now.
Boxes designed to keep a smash burger hot on the walk home. Testing starts next month.
Every brand follows the same loop. You collect from the counter at 93 Leigh Broadway, and what you tell us shapes what we cook next.
New ideas start on the pass, not in a boardroom. We cook what we want to eat.
Fresh, every day, in one fixed kitchen on Leigh Broadway. No shortcuts, no reheating.
Order ahead, walk to the counter and take it home hot. Collection only, always.
You tell us what worked. We tweak, retire or double down. Then the loop starts again.
You try it. We listen. Together, we discover what comes next.
Leigh-on-Sea, Essex. Look for the red sign; the counter is right at the front.
